subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: Know the reflexive pronouns: myself, yourself, himself and more.
Use a reflexive pronoun when the subject and object are the same.
Choose between object pronouns (me, him) and reflexive pronouns.

tf.s: We use reflexive pronouns when the subject and the object are the same.
tf.why: Yes! I hurt myself: I is the subject and myself is the object.

tf.s: “She hurt himself in the swimming pool” is correct.
The reflexive pronoun for an animal or thing is “itself”.
“We called Jasim and told himself to bring some food” is correct.
tf.why: The subject is we, not Jasim, so we use him.

tf.s: “Myself have prepared a new blog” is correct.
tf.why: We use the subject pronoun: I have prepared a new blog.

tf.s: Majid is looking for his trainers because he wants to go skateboarding.
tf.why: Yes, he needs them for skateboarding.
Hazim doesn’t want to be under the water.

tf.s: Saeed feels proud because he did rock climbing even though he was scared.

boxes.q: I hurt ___ when I fell off my bike.
The camel hurt ___ when it was running.
boxes.why: For an animal we use itself.

boxes.q: Have you made ___ some lunch? (you – plural)
Are your friends enjoying ___ at the stadium?
My teacher spoke to my father and ___.
boxes.why: The subject is my teacher, so we use me.

boxes.q: ___ have prepared a new sports blog.
boxes.why: The subject needs a subject pronoun.

boxes.q: Did you make it ___? (you – one person)

o: in the bedroom, next to the bed
boxes.why: They were next to his bed.

boxes.q: When did Hazim go mountain biking?
boxes.why: He went on holiday last year.

mcq.q: When do we use reflexive pronouns?
o: When the subject and the object of the verb are the same
When we talk about the future
When the subject is plural only

mcq.q: Which list has only reflexive pronouns?
Why doesn’t Hazim want to go diving?
o: He doesn’t want to be under the water.
mcq.why: Hazim doesn’t like being under the water.

o: He was scared about rock climbing, but he did it.
mcq.why: He did something that scared him.

mcq.q: Change: “We hurt our heads when we were rock climbing.”
o: We hurt ourselves when we were rock climbing.
We hurt us when we were rock climbing.
We hurt themselves when we were rock climbing.
We hurt ourself when we were rock climbing.

mcq.q: Complete: “Our cat hurt ___ when it was playing in the garden.”
Complete: “They cut ___ when they were go-karting.”

o: I write notes to me myself.
mcq.why: I is the subject and myself is the object.

mcq.q: Why is “We called Jasim and told him to bring food” correct, not “himself”?
o: The subject (we) and the object (Jasim) are different people.
mcq.why: Reflexive pronouns are only for the same person.

mcq.q: Which sentence about yourself uses “enjoy myself” correctly?
o: I enjoy myself when I play football.
I enjoy me when I play football.
